name: dsh-knit
description: Task-aware workspace context retrieval for DeepSeek Harness. Ranks the workspace's documents and code by relevance to the current conversation, shows the Context Pack (primary / supporting / related) in the sidebar with inline preview, and tracks which of them the agent actually read and what changed after. Zero model calls, zero network.
